notes.title: Chapter map: Audio cleanup

headings.text: 🌳 Decide: what to do about echo and noise

notes.html:
Everything that makes the microphone signal mostly the person's voice before VAD and STT listen: echo cancellation on the device, noise suppression in two layers, and a server-side guard for when echo slips through.

Where this sits

capture → carry → clean → detect → transcribe → endpoint → think → speak → yield → observe

Reading order

# Note Tier Stage You'll understand
1 Echo cancellation CORE clean the adaptive filter, convergence, double talk, why on the device
2 Noise suppression SUPPORTING clean browser vs neural, nc vs bvc
3 Server-side echo guard SUPPORTING clean keeping the agent's words out of the transcript
– AGC, headphones, ducking BREADTH capture cheap client-side helps

Owners

Concept Home
AEC, ERLE, convergence, double talk echo cancellation
Browser NS, Krisp modes noise suppression
Dropping echoed turns, re-saying echo guard
What barge-in does on echo barge-in
Testing in noise and with speakers evaluating a voice agent

Decide: what to do about echo and noise

Ask in order If yes → Because
1. Can you require headphones? do it no acoustic path
2. Otherwise device AEC on, plus a tone before the first question the filter converges first
3. Is the room noisy with other voices? try a stronger neural mode per device, measured it may remove the speaker
4. Always a server-side guard on the transcript a miss is silently wrong

🔊 Our system in one table

What Status Note
Browser AEC, NS, AGC, mono lib/audio.ts
Device check with a test tone lets AEC converge
Krisp nc in the agent bvc dropped a quiet mic, 26 Sep 2026
Echo guard fixed and checked live, 13 Oct 2026
Headphone detection, ducking targets

Game Day

Q35 echo as testimony · Q14 network degrades

notes.title: Echo Cancellation — Why the Agent Hears Itself
notes.html:
References

~/Projects/tech_documentation/interview_prep/05-echo-cancellation.md · ~/Projects/tech_documentation/ADR/voice_pipeline/voice_pipeline_design.md §4 · ~/Projects/convo_client/src/lib/audio.ts, components/DeviceCheck.tsx · W3C — MediaTrackConstraints echoCancellation

TL;DR

On laptop speakers the agent's voice comes back through the person's microphone. Acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) knows what was just played, models how the room bends it, and subtracts the prediction from the mic signal. It has to run on the device, it needs a few seconds to learn the room, and it struggles most when both people talk at once.

Stage: capture → carry → clean → detect → transcribe → endpoint → think → speak → yield → observe · per frame

Flow: agent audio played(reference)adaptive filter predicts the echomic − predictionresidual suppressorclean mic frame

Recall

Prompt Answer
What AEC needs that a server doesn't have the exact far-end reference, sample-aligned with the speaker
The core algorithm an adaptive filter (NLMS/RLS) modelling the echo path, then a non-linear suppressor
The hard case double talk: both speak at once; adaptation must freeze
Convergence time ~3–4 s, so the agent's first line is the most echo-prone moment
The quality number ERLE: dB of echo removed
Draw the echo path and the filter speaker → room → mic, with the reference feeding the filter and a subtraction

The idea

Without it: the agent's words come back as speech. Turn detection thinks the person is talking, barge-in stops the agent mid-word, and the STT writes the agent's question into the person's transcript.

It does: removes the predicted echo frame by frame, before anything downstream listens.

It costs: a learning period at the start, imperfect cancellation in hard rooms, and some damage to the person's voice during double talk.

How it works

Rule Because
Run AEC in the browser (echoCancellation: true) only the client has the reference aligned with its own speaker
Play audio before the first real question the filter converges on throwaway sound, not on the opening line
Recommend headphones no acoustic path, no echo
Keep a server-side guard behind it a miss is silently wrong: the agent's words scored as the person's (echo guard)

Knobs

Knob Default Trade
echoCancellation on in WebRTC capture off only with headphones and for raw-audio needs
Device check playing audio first – a few seconds of setup vs an echo-prone opening
Headphones user's choice best fix; a hard gate if echo stays high

🔊 In our system

What Value Status Why / source
Browser capture echoCancellation, noiseSuppression, autoGainControl on, mono convo_client/src/lib/audio.ts
Device check mic meter and a speaker test tone; the tone also lets AEC converge DeviceCheck.tsx
Server guard drops a turn that repeats the agent's recent words echo guard
Headphone detection and ducking planned as_built row 1 target
Rule if echo_suppressed_total runs high, mandatory headphones design §4

Measure it

  • Metric — echo-guard drops per call, false barge-ins attributed to echo, ERLE where the platform exposes it.
  • See it — ECHO suppressed (overlap …) log lines; calls with speakers vs headphones compared.
  • Bounded by — the server guard, re-asking a cut-off question, a headphone requirement.

Pitfalls

Cancelling echo on the server

  • Why it's tempting: the server sees both streams.
  • Why it's wrong: it doesn't have the reference as the speaker played it, with the device's delay and the room; it's guessing.
  • Think instead: AEC on the device; the server only guards the transcript.

Judging AEC on the first sentence

  • Why it's tempting: the greeting is the first thing you hear in a test.
  • Why it's wrong: the filter hasn't converged yet; the first line is the worst case.
  • Think instead: converge on a device-check tone, then test mid-call.

Connections

capture → carry → clean → detect → … — the first line of defence for every later stage.

  • protects VAD and barge-in from the agent's own voice.
  • backed by the server-side echo guard.
  • Say it: Q35

notes.title: Noise Suppression and Background-Voice Removal
notes.html:
References

~/Projects/tech_documentation/ADR/voice_pipeline/transcript_quality.md §1–2, §7 · ~/Projects/tech_documentation/ADR/voice_pipeline/as_built.md §2 row 3 · LiveKit — Noise cancellation

TL;DR

Two layers: the browser's classical noise suppression (cheap, conservative, good on steady noise) and a neural model in the agent (Krisp on LiveKit Cloud) that removes non-steady noise and, in bvc mode, other people's voices. The stronger the filter, the higher the risk it removes the speaker too.

Stage: capture → carry → clean → detect → transcribe → endpoint → think → speak → yield → observe · per frame

Flow: mic ─browser NS (steady noise)networkVAD + STT

Recall

Prompt Answer
Browser NS works how per ~10 ms frame, lowers bands that barely rise above the estimated steady noise (Wiener-style)
Neural NS works how predicts a mask per frequency band: voice vs everything else
nc vs bvc noise only vs noise + background voices (keeps one primary speaker)
What bvc did on 26 Sep 2026 removed a quiet laptop mic's voice entirely
Is noise our main recognition loss? no: ≤ 3–4 points of term recall even at 5 dB SNR
Draw the two layers and what each removes browser: fan, hum · neural: keyboard, door, TV voices

The idea

Without it: VAD fires on a door slam, STT hears a TV, and the turn detector waits on noise.

It does: hands VAD and STT a signal that is mostly the person's voice.

It costs: every filter can damage speech; a filter that removes "other voices" can decide the quiet speaker is the other voice.

How it works

Layer Removes Misses Risk
Browser NS steady noise (fan, AC hum) keyboard, traffic, voices low
Neural nc steady and non-steady noise other voices low
Neural bvc noise and other voices – removes a quiet primary speaker; weakens the second-voice signal

Knobs

Knob Our value Trade
Browser noiseSuppression on –
Agent noise mode (NOISE_CANCELLATION) nc bvc: cleaner TV rooms, risk of losing the speaker
Per-device choice not built bvc for headsets only if it never drops the primary voice

🔊 In our system

What Value Status Why / source
Agent noise mode Krisp nc (noise only) as_built row 3
Finding bvc removed a quiet laptop mic entirely on a live call 26 Sep 2026
Noise study brown noise + 100 Hz hum at 15/10/5 dB: ≤ 3–4 points of recall lost transcript_quality §7 (before Krisp)

Measure it

  • Metric — term recall and WER at fixed SNRs per mode; empty-transcript rate per mode.
  • See it — goldens/stt_tts --noise; real recordings in noisy rooms (none yet).
  • Bounded by — default to the gentler mode; a repeat request on empty turns.

Pitfalls

Picking the strongest mode by default

  • Why it's tempting: more removal sounds better.
  • Why it's wrong: it removed the person on a quiet mic; a transcript of nothing is worse than a noisy one.
  • Think instead: gentle by default, stronger only per device after measuring on real recordings.

Connections

… → clean → detect → … — what VAD and STT receive.

  • runs beside echo cancellation.
  • measured in the test-conditions matrix (fan noise, background voices).
  • weakens the diarization signal in bvc mode.

notes.title: The Server-Side Echo Guard — The Agent's Words Are Never Testimony
notes.html:
References

~/Projects/tech_documentation/FLOW_WALKTHROUGHS.md §2 · ~/Projects/tech_documentation/ADR/voice_pipeline/voice_pipeline_design.md §4 · ~/Projects/convo_agentic/meghdootam/voice/echo.py, tests/test_echo.py

TL;DR

When echo cancellation misses, the STT transcribes the agent's own words as the person's. A cheap text check in the agent drops any user turn that began while the agent was speaking (or just after) and is made of long stretches of the agent's recent replies, before it reaches the brain or the transcript. It can't stop the interruption; it stops the bad record.

Stage: capture → carry → clean → detect → transcribe → endpoint → think → speak → yield → observe · per turn

Flow: user turn committedbegan during or ≤ 1.5 s after agent speech?made of runs of her last 3 replies?drop + re-say (≤ 2)normal turn

Recall

Prompt Answer
What it protects the transcript and the score, not the conversation
Why it can't prevent the interruption barge-in fires ~150 ms in; no transcript exists yet
The two questions it asks did the sound begin while she spoke? is the text made of her recent words?
What happens to a dropped echo the reply is said again, at most twice
The 13 Oct 2026 bug matching letters and judging by commit time: short real turns dropped, real echoes let through
Draw an echo and a real "Are you there?" on one timeline echo begins during her speech and repeats her words; the real one begins after

The idea

Without it: a candidate on speakers "answers" with the agent's question, and the scorer grades it.

It does: a string check with timing, in the hook after the user's turn, raising StopResponse.

It costs: false drops if the check is loose; a re-said reply when an echo cut the agent off.

How it works

Setting Value Because
Window sound begins while the agent speaks, or within 1.5 s after echoes start during playback
Match ≥ 8 letters in a row of the agent's last 3 replies, overlap ≥ 0.8 short real turns share letters with any long question
Re-says per reply 2 (MAX_RESPEAKS) an echo loop can't become a loop of model calls
Where on_user_turn_completed → StopResponse before the brain and the transcript

Knobs

Knob Raise it → Lower it →
Overlap threshold (0.8) fewer false drops, more echoes kept more echoes dropped, real turns at risk
Window (1.5 s) catches late echoes real quick replies safer

🔊 In our system

What Value Status Why / source
Guard voice/echo.py, tested in tests/test_echo.py –
Fixed and checked playing her own question back on a live call: dropped twice, re-asked each time live_voice --echo, 13 Oct 2026

Measure it

  • Metric — drops per call (high → headphones), false drops on labelled turns.
  • See it — ECHO suppressed (overlap 1.00, …), ECHO cut the reply off: saying it again (1 of 2).
  • Bounded by — two re-says per reply.

Pitfalls

Judging by when the turn was committed

  • Why it's tempting: the commit time is what the code has.
  • Why it's wrong: commit comes seconds after the echo ended, so real echoes fall outside the window.
  • Think instead: judge by when the sound began.

Connections

… → clean → … — defence in depth behind AEC.

  • backs up echo cancellation.
  • runs in the hook described in the agent session.
  • interacts with barge-in.
  • Say it: Q35
